title: November Guest Artist Susan Overstreet
paragraphs: Susan Overstreet, a Cape oil painter, will be the presenter at the next meeting of the Guild of Harwich Artists on Saturday, November 18, 2017 at the Harwich Community Center. The presentation, from 2 to 4 PM, is free and open to the public.

Susan’s bold, expressive style spans subject matter from dramatic figure and portraiture, to exuberant florals and the Cape Cod environment. Susan completed studio work at George Washington University, and continued studying fine arts at the Corcoran School of Art and the Art League School of Alexandria. Susan has exhibited at The Provincetown Art Museum, the Cape Cod Cultural Center, the Cape Cod Art Museum and is represented by the Addison Art Gallery in Orleans (addisonart.com).

pwsbuilder November 12, 2017

Susan Overstreet, a Cape oil painter, will be the presenter at the next meeting of the Guild of Harwich Artists on Saturday, November 18, 2017 at the Harwich Community Center. The presentation, from 2 to 4 PM, is free and open to the public. 

Susan’s bold, expressive style spans subject matter from dramatic figure and portraiture, to exuberant florals and the Cape Cod environment. Susan completed studio work at George Washington University, and continued studying fine arts at the Corcoran School of Art and the Art League School of Alexandria. Susan has exhibited at The Provincetown Art Museum, the Cape Cod Cultural Center, the Cape Cod Art Museum and is represented by the Addison Art Gallery in Orleans (addisonart.com).
